question: According to census 2011, the only Indian state having negative decadal population growth rate between 2001-11 is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nagaland **had a negative decadal population growth rate of **-0.5% between 2001-11, **according to the Census 2011.
 
• **Goa** had a decadal growth rate of 8.23%, **Uttarakhand **had a growth rate of 18.81%, and** Sikkim **had a growth rate of 12.36%.
